name: industries
description: Dark indigo panel of sector cards over a blurred colour field; each card is a whole-card link with a photo, sector icon, description and an Explore line. Ported from the live homepage (#ap-sector-intelligence-v4); phones add a sticky row of sector chips.

section_id.description: The section's id, the target of the mega menu's View All Industries link (/#industries). Empty for none.

tabs_label.description: Accessible name of the phone chip row. Falls back to the title when empty.

items.description: Sector cards. Each: title and body (required); optional image (photo URL), icon (government, manufacturing, healthcare, education, construction, nonprofit — also sets the card's sector class), link_label, link_url (makes the whole card a link) and anchor (the card's id, which its chip jumps to; generated when empty).

reveal.description: Stagger cards in on scroll. The live homepage section has no entrance animation (false).
